decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Fires of Invention and utilizing powerful control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards that allow for card advantage and ensuring the player maintains a strong board presence. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion adds an additional card draw engine to the deck. Overall, the key strategy revolves around controlling the game tempo, establishing a strong board presence, and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on creating a fast, aggressive strategy by attaching powerful aura spells to creatures, boosting their strength and providing evasion abilities. The key goal is to quickly build up a strong, resilient creature that can deal significant damage to the opponent. The inclusion of a companion adds extra versatility and consistency to the deck. With a mix of protection, evasion, and creature enhancements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can mount a proper defense.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying a variety of small and efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of angels and Valkyries, the deck aims to curve out with aggressive creatures while also providing support with cards like Collected Company and Righteous Valkyrie. The inclusion of cards like Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition allows for removal of key threats, while cards like Resplendent Angel provide a powerful finisher. The deck also includes mana-fixing lands and a toolbox of creatures to adapt to various matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost white creatures, also known as "weenies," while using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to pump up the team and make them more powerful. The deck aims to be aggressive and fast-paced, quickly building a board presence and attacking relentlessly. Cards like Brutal Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben also help to disrupt the opponent's plans and keep them on their toes. With a mix of efficient creatures and support spells, this deck aims to win the game quickly through sheer numbers and aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to search for and bring out powerful creatures to control the board. With a variety of creatures with different abilities and high mana cost, as well as enchantments and artifacts to support them, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while controlling the game. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility. The key strategy is to efficiently utilize Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly improve your board state and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and aggressive creatures like Kroxa and Bonecrusher Giant. With efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, this deck aims to control the board and close out games with powerful finishers such as Sheoldred and Misery's Shadow. The deck also utilizes a mixture of lands to ensure consistent mana production and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly develop a board presence with aggressive creatures like Youthful Valkyrie and Righteous Valkyrie, while using cards like Kayla's Reconstruction and Collected Company to further strengthen the board. Cards like Resplendent Angel and Giada, Font of Hope provide additional threats and resilience. The deck also includes removal options like Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of untapped white sources and utility lands.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and board wipes while generating card advantage with card draw spells. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to maintain control of the game and win through incremental advantage. The inclusion of Shark Typhoon allows for a win condition that can bypass traditional creature-based strategies. The deck also includes utility lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Field of Ruin to deal with problematic threats. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure a victory through careful resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing green mana devotion to ramp into powerful creatures and planeswalkers quickly. By utilizing cards like Nissa, Who Shakes the World, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Wolfwillow Haven to generate massive amounts of mana, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with heavy hitters like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to provide additional value and disruption to opponents. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around quickly ramping up mana and deploying big threats to dominate the board.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful green cards that have a high devotion to green. The deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Wolfwillow Haven to accelerate mana production. By using cards like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Vraska, Golgari Queen, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and powerful abilities. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to further enhance its strategy and maintain a strong board presence.

This control deck aims to utilize the Fires of Invention enchantment to cast powerful spells for free, enabling a lockdown on the opponent's board. With a mix of powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Kenrith, the Returned King, along with removal spells like Bonecrusher Giant and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can control the battlefield effectively. The addition of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion allows for card advantage and consistency in drawing into more threats and answers. By efficiently managing resources and setting up a strong board presence, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly, utilizing efficient creatures and burn spells to control the board and deal damage. With a mix of cost-effective creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker, along with powerful spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic allows for explosive starts, while land cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Den of the Bugbear provide additional utility and flexibility in gameplay.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Graveyard Trespasser and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional threats that can be difficult for opponents to deal with. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells in Rakdos colors. Utilizing efficient threats like Kroxa, Bonecrusher Giant, and Sheoldred, the deck aims to quickly pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for additional aggression and synergy with the rest of the deck. The mana base is constructed to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Glorybringer, Bonecrusher Giant, and Graveyard Trespasser to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to clear the way for your creatures. Misery's Shadow and Bloodtithe Harvester provide additional ways to pressure the opponent's life total. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate card advantage and fuel your aggression. The mana base is built to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of Swamps, Mountains, and dual lands.

The main focus of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro - Weenie White deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By playing low-cost creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant, along with pump spells like Brave the Elements, the deck aims to create a wide board presence and quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to further bolster its creatures and maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mana base focused on Plains and utility lands, the deck aims to consistently curve out and apply pressure early in the game.

The main concept of this deck is to create a strong board presence through aggressive green creatures while maximizing devotion to green for powerful effects. By utilizing mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate mana production, along with cards like Old-Growth Troll and Storm the Festival to put pressure on the opponent, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Adding powerful cards like Sylvan Caryatid and Cavalier of Thorns for additional board presence and resilience, this deck focuses on ramping up mana and winning through efficient beatdown strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana using mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, as well as enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven, to cast powerful green spells and creatures. The deck also revolves around devotion to green, utilizing cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and cards like Vraska, Golgari Queen and Old-Growth Troll to take advantage of high green mana symbols in their mana costs. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast mana acceleration and powerful creatures to establish board control and pressure.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana using green devotion cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and then play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to quickly overwhelm your opponent. Additionally, cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck also includes a small blue splash for cards like Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to provide more versatility and control options.

The deck focuses on using Fires of Invention to cast powerful spells without having to pay their mana cost. It includes a mix of creatures like Colossal Skyturtle and Cavalier of Flame, along with versatile spells like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Supreme Verdict. Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown help control the board while Keruga, the Macrosage provides card advantage. The mana base is diverse, allowing for flexibility in casting spells of various colors. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with strong creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining control of the board.

The deck focuses on using graveyard synergy and card advantage to fuel a powerful combo involving Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. The strategy revolves around milling cards with cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Satyr Wayfinder, while also utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage to fill the graveyard. The combo is supported by cards like Esika's Chariot and Raffine's Informant to help assemble the pieces, with disruption provided by cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also includes some utility lands and removal spells to round out the strategy.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It looks to establish early board presence with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, followed by powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck also has a strong land base, with utility lands like Lair of the Hydra and Mutavault to ensure consistent mana production and strong late-game options.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around casting low-cost spells to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability and bring it back from the graveyard. The deck also utilizes cards like Ledger Shredder and Temporal Trespass to fuel the graveyard and draw additional cards. The inclusion of Thing in the Ice provides a backup win condition while Galvanic Iteration allows for extra spell copies to maximize Phoenix triggers. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient spellcasting to bring out multiple threats and close out the game swiftly.
